# express-controller-sets

> Generate list, read, create, update and delete endpoints for any Mongoose model in one call — with filtering, search, pagination, S3 uploads, authentication and a security model that denies by default.

Install: `npm install express-controller-sets express mongoose`. ES modules, Node 20+, Express 5, Mongoose 9.
For a complete, self-contained guide written for language models, read https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/llms-full.txt.

## Get started

- [Overview](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/): What the library is and what one call gives you.
- [Quickstart](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/quickstart.html): A working API in one file, in five minutes.
- [How to use](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/how-to-use.html): Put CRUD, auth, uploads and email together — plus ready-made answers to common tasks.

## CRUD

- [Endpoints & responses](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/endpoints.html): The six routes every router serves, and what they return.
- [Filter, search & paginate](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/filtering.html): Let clients find records — only by the fields you allow.
- [Create, update & validate](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/writing.html): Choose which fields clients may write, and check them before saving.

## S3 Upload

- [Upload files](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/uploads.html): Accept files with a record and store them in S3-compatible storage.
- [S3 setup](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/s3.html): Connect AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, DigitalOcean Spaces or MinIO.

## Dynamic Router

- [Router & middlewares](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/router.html): Mount, guard and split the generated routes.
- [HTTP QUERY](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/http-query.html): Reads whose filters travel in a JSON body.
- [Custom routes](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/custom-routes.html): Use the handlers on your own router.

## Auth

- [Auth setup](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/auth.html): Sign-up, login, roles and route guards on your own user model.
- [Refresh tokens](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/auth-refresh.html): Short access tokens, long sessions — with rotation on or off.
- [Social sign-in](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/auth-social.html): Google, Apple, Facebook, GitHub — or any provider.

## Email Sender

- [Email Sender](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/email.html): Send password-reset codes with your transporter, sender and templates.

## .env examples

- [.env examples](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/env.html): Every environment variable, with ready-made setups for common providers.

## Reference

- [All options](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/options.html): Every option, default and export.
- [FAQ](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/faq.html): Answers to the questions people hit first.
- [Use with an LLM](https://ornate-source.github.io/controllerSets/llm.html): One prompt so ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot write correct code for this package.
